coreTypes.sourceNote: Core types sync from the product catalog — they are not created or deleted here. The standard pre-fills new batches and applies to cores with no known batch (factory-fitted cores, pending batches).
coreTypes.thresholdNote: Warning thresholds are system defaults shared by every core type: the app turns yellow when a core has {{warning}}% of its lifespan left and red at {{critical}}%.
coreTypes.floorNote: Floor: when confirming a batch (e.g. one shipped to a poor-water area), R&D may shorten its lifespan but not below the core type's floor — so the app never asks customers to replace cores that are still good.
coreTypes.floorTooltip: How far a batch lifespan may be shortened, as a % of the standard. E.g. PP5 standard 12 months · 250 h, floor 40% → shortest batch 5 months · 100 h.

coreTypeModal.title: Edit core type {{name}}
coreTypeModal.monthsRange: Lifespan must be a whole number from 1 to 60 months.
coreTypeModal.floorPercent: Floor when shortening a batch (% of standard)
coreTypeModal.floorHint: When confirming a batch lifespan, R&D cannot go below this.
coreTypeModal.impact: Applies to {{pending}} pending batch(es) (using the standard) and future batches. {{confirmed}} confirmed batch(es) keep their value. Activated cores do not change.
coreTypeModal.hoursRange: Hours must be a whole number from 1 to 20,000.
coreTypeModal.thresholdPreview: App warning thresholds (system defaults, not editable):
coreTypeModal.floorExample: → Batches of this core type last at least {{months}} months · {{hours}} h.
